mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plant_maintenance (pid, pname, mtype, mdate, operator, health_status, notes) VALUES (#{pid}, #{pname}, #{mtype}, #{mdate}, #{operator}, #{healthStatus}, #{notes})
mapper.select:
SELECT mid, pid, pname, mtype, mdate, operator, health_status, notes FROM plant_maintenance
AND ( pid LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR operator LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR notes LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND mtype = #{mtype}
ORDER BY mid DESC
SELECT mid, pid, pname, mtype, mdate, operator, health_status, notes FROM plant_maintenance ORDER BY mid ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plant_maintenance WHERE mdate LIKE CONCAT(#{todayPrefix}, '%')
SELECT mid, pid, pname, mtype, mdate, operator, health_status, notes FROM plant_maintenance WHERE pid = #{pid} ORDER BY mid DESC
SELECT mid, pid, pname, mtype, mdate, operator, health_status, notes FROM plant_maintenance ORDER BY mid DESC LIMIT #{limit}
